front.title: WebAssembly Framework for Network Management in Heterogeneous Edge Networks

abstract.t: This document describes an architecture for executing WebAssembly (WASM) modules for network management on heterogeneous edge devices. It describes dynamic bytecode dispatching, the Universal Bytecode Interface (UBI) for abstracting heterogeneous network element capabilities, and metadata models for capability exposure, bytecode deployment, execution context, intent-driven discovery, and security audits. The framework decouples management scripts from platform- specific interfaces. It reuses existing mechanisms for software update, payload manifests, integrity protection, and transport where applicable.
